descriptionChirho: Qal stem: to draw off, remove, or strip away something physical such as sandals, clothing, or a body part from its place.
Qal stem used intransitively: to pull oneself away, withdraw, or retreat from a situation or place.
Piel stem: to rescue, deliver, or save someone from danger, distress, or enemies.
Piel stem: to forcibly extract, tear out, or strip away physical objects such as stones from a wall, or to despoil.
Nifal stem (passive): to be rescued, delivered, or saved from danger or enemies.
